summary: Completed comprehensive testing of the new Sales screen with cart system and country flags (🇩🇴/🇺🇸) features. All 18 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verification confirmed all cart system steps and country flags are working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/tickets/multi endpoint correctly validates: empty plays, invalid lottery type, number counts per lottery type, number range validation
Multi-play ticket creation returns: id, ticket_number, plays array, total_amount, total_potential_win, commission_earned
Frontend sales.tsx has 4-step cart system: 1) Select Lotteries (with type filter), 2) Enter Numbers, 3) Amount & Add to Cart, 4) Cart with totals and Create Ticket button
Country flags (🇩🇴/🇺🇸) properly displayed in: Dashboard stats, Sellers Report totals and per-seller stats, Sales page lottery chips and cart items
Country filter (Todos/RD/USA) working correctly in Dashboard and Sellers Report for super_admin role

success_rate.frontend: 100% - All cart system features and country flags verified

seed_data_creation: Created test multi-play tickets during API testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: New sales screen with cart system fully functional. The 4-step process allows: selecting multiple lotteries of same type, entering numbers, adding to cart with amount, and creating multi-play ticket via POST /api/tickets/multi. Country flags display correctly in formatCurrency function using 'RD' vs 'USA/US' country values.

POST /api/tickets/multi - Empty plays va.notes: Returns 400 'Debe incluir al menos una jugada'

POST /api/tickets/multi - Number range v.notes: Returns 400 'fuera de rango' for numbers outside lottery range

POST /api/tickets/multi - Create single.notes: Creates ticket with ticket_number, plays array, totals, commission

POST /api/tickets/multi - Create multipl.notes: Creates ticket with 3 plays, correct total (60), plays_count (3)

GET /api/lotteries - Returns country fie.notes: All lotteries have country field (RD, USA, TEST)

GET /api/accounting/summary - Returns cu.notes: Returns currency field for flag display

Frontend - Sales page 4-step cart system.notes: Step 1: Select Lotteries (with type filter), Step 2: Enter Numbers (with quick pick), Step 3: Amount & Add to Cart, Step 4: Cart with totals and Create Ticket

Frontend - Lottery type filter chips.notes: Shows Todas, Loto, Mega_millions, Pale, Pega3, Powerball, Quiniela, Tripleta

Frontend - Multiple lottery selection.notes: Can select multiple lotteries, shows count '1 lotería(s) seleccionada(s)'

Frontend - Number entry and display.notes: Numbers shown as green balls in cart items

Frontend - Cart with country flags.notes: Cart items show 🇩🇴 flag next to lottery name

Frontend - Cart totals and Create Ticket.notes: Shows Total a Pagar, Premio Potencial, and 'Crear Ticket (N jugadas)' button

Frontend - Dashboard country filter.notes: Shows 'Filtrar por país:' with Todos/RD/USA buttons for super_admin

Frontend - Dashboard flags in formatCurr.notes: 🇩🇴 flag shown next to RD$ amounts in stats cards

Frontend - Sellers Report country filter.notes: Shows 'Filtrar por país:' with Todos/RD/USA buttons

Frontend - Sellers Report flags.notes: 🇩🇴 flag shown next to RD$ amounts in totals and per-seller stats
